integrity_and_limitations: Proved exact maximal-index stratum and top-power canonical rank only for incidence algebras of ordinal sums of nonempty antichains, in every finite characteristic. The rank refinement is representation-dependent; nilpotency index is intrinsic. Smaller-index strata, full Jordan forms, automorphism orbits, general posets, and independent historical priority are not established. Numerical verification tests finite cases and does not replace the proof.
title: Exact maximal nilpotency-index census in layered incidence-algebra radicals
